_what: The printed headings on 433-B, and the band each one opens. A widget belongs to the band its RECTANGLE sits in, and a group belongs to the heading whose band its rows are drawn under. Both coordinate sets come from adapters/pdf/page-geometry.mjs, so this file and the map cannot disagree about where anything is.
_why: A group bound under the wrong heading writes a row into the wrong printed table, and nothing about the leaf names would say so on this form — page 1's names are p1_24_6a and p1_33_7aFullNm, which name a row and a column and never a table. The band is the check.
_band_rule: A heading's band runs from its own baseline DOWN to the next declared heading on the same page, or to the foot of the page if there is none below it. Declared here rather than derived so a heading nobody wrote down cannot silently widen the band above it.
_slice: Slices 1 to 3. Pages 1 to 4. Pages 5 and 6 declare no heading here yet and are NOT claimed to have none — that absence is about this file, not about the form.

_no_other_group_on_page_1: The map declares three groups and page 1 draws three repeating blocks. Everything else on the page is a scalar: Section 1's eleven left-column cells and sixteen right-column cells are one-per-page facts about the entity, not rows. The 2b entity list is five checkboxes in one exclusive set rather than a repeating block — five options for one fact, not five rows of the same fact.
_no_other_group_on_pages_2_and_3: Five groups are declared for these two pages and the map binds no sixth on either. Derived rather than asserted: adapters/pdf/verify-headings.mjs takes every group in the map whose slots bind a page-2 or page-3 target and requires a heading declaration for each, so a group added to the map without one is a STOP rather than a silence.
_no_other_group_on_page_4: Two groups are declared for this page and the map binds no third on it. Derived rather than asserted: adapters/pdf/verify-headings.mjs takes every group in the map whose slots bind a page-4 target and requires a heading declaration for each, so a group added to the map without one is a STOP rather than a silence.
